meta.name: token-efficiency
meta.description: Reduce token waste by 40-60% through anti-sycophancy rules, tool-call budgets, one-pass coding, task profiles, and read-before-write enforcement. Inspired by drona23/claude-token-efficient.

copy.tagline: 减少大语言模型交互中的令牌浪费
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用大语言模型时经常超出令牌限制或费用过高。
copy.tagline_en: Reduce token waste in LLM interactions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often exceed token limits or incur high costs when using large language models.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会减少废话和重复操作，直接给出答案或代码，避免不必要的文件重读和多次迭代，从而节省 token。
howto.when: 当对话感觉变慢或输出冗长时，或者开始新项目时，可以启用此技能。

say.text: 帮我优化这段代码，一次完成。
say.note: Claude 会一次性写出完整解决方案，不逐步修改。

say.text: 分析这个错误，直接给出修复。
say.note: Claude 会先读错误输出，然后直接修复，不绕弯子。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude reduces filler text and redundant operations, directly providing answers or code, avoiding unnecessary file re-reads and multiple iterations, thus saving tokens.
howto.when_en: Enable when sessions feel slow or output is verbose, or when starting a new project for token-efficient work.

say_en.text: Optimize this code in one pass.
say_en.note: Claude will write the complete solution at once, not incrementally.

say_en.text: Analyze this error and fix it directly.
say_en.note: Claude will read the error output first, then fix without preamble.
